upstream.note: Structured incident metadata + factual summaries; every row deep-links the original.

incidents.title: Walgreens: Claimed on a leak site, not confirmed
incidents.description: Claimed on a ransomware leak site on 28 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. A ransomware group called Wallstreet claimed to have accessed Walgreens' systems in November 2026, exposing customer health information. Walgreens has not publicly confirmed that a breach occurred. United States.

incidents.title: Korea Post (Internet Post Office): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Korea Post's Internet Post Office said that a hacking attack using overseas IP addresses exposed the names, addresses and phone numbers of registered-mail customers. Analysis of a single day's data alone identified 113,855 affected customers. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Seoul, South Korea.

incidents.title: Pacific Blue Cross: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Pacific Blue Cross experienced a cyber incident that caused its website and contact centre to go offline, preventing members from accessing services. The company confirmed the incident in a notice on its website and is working with external specialists to investigate and restore systems. Burnaby, Canada.

incidents.title: 日本経済新聞社: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. An unauthorized access to the external service KARTE used by Nikkei resulted in the leakage of approximately 5.4 million personal records. Nikkei has confirmed the breach and apologized to affected individuals. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Salamerija Alpija: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. A hacker attack blocked the internet‑connected refrigeration system at the Salamerija Alpija meat plant in Tolmino, Slovenia, displaying a photo of Italian politician Matteo Salvini. The plant’s director confirmed the intrusion was stopped, no damage occurred, and the systems were manually reset. Slovenia.

incidents.title: Planet IC: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Planet IC, an IT service provider in Schwerin, suffered unauthorised access to its servers on the evening of 21 November, knocking out numerous client websites. Customer data of the energy supplier WEMAG was probably stolen. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Schwerin, Germany.

incidents.title: StudySmarter: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. StudySmarter disclosed a serious cyberattack in which email addresses and password hashes were stolen, with millions of users worldwide told to change their passwords. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Munich, Germany.

incidents.title: SoftwareOK: Confirmed supply chain attack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. A software supply-chain attack trojanized the Q-Dir and DesktopOK installers. Germany.

incidents.title: Mittwald: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The web hosting provider was hacked in mid-November 2026 and published a postmortem on the intrusion. Germany.

incidents.title: boerse.de: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Unauthorized third parties gained access to personal contact and master data such as names and addresses from the customer base. Germany.

incidents.title: Granada CF: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. A third party accessed a technology platform supporting Granada CF's digital services and extracted subscriber data including ID, email, name, and national identity number. Granada, Spain.

incidents.title: Bic Camera: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. 154,034 records were potentially exposed through unauthorized access to part of Bic Camera's own systems, affecting Kojima and Sofmap. Takada, Japan.

incidents.title: Omura City: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Parents' and children's personal data was exposed through unauthorized access to KARTE used by Unifa's Lookme childcare support system. Nagasaki, Japan.

incidents.victim: KOFST (Korea Scientists and Engineers Mutual-Aid Association)
incidents.title: KOFST (Korea Scientists and Engineers Mutual-Aid Association): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. KOFST disclosed that a cyberattack leaked roughly 210,000 member records across 16 data categories, including encrypted resident registration numbers and home addresses. The attack occurred on 8 November and was publicly disclosed on 27 November 2026. Seoul, South Korea.

incidents.title: pCloud Pass: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. A cyberattack was promptly contained, but a small number of email addresses associated with pCloud Pass accounts were accessed. Switzerland.

incidents.title: hattrick.org: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. An attacker copied the user database covering all hattrick.org accounts. Stockholm, Sweden.

incidents.title: GMO Pepabo: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. GMO Pepabo reported that unauthorised access to its systems leaked over 510,000 user records from its rental server and cloud services, including some passwords. The incident was disclosed on 27 November 2026. Fukuoka, Japan.

incidents.title: Daimaru Matsuzakaya Department Store: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Daimaru Matsuzakaya Department Store reported that information from its online store leaked, totalling more than 880,000 records. The disclosure occurred on 27 November 2026. Osaka, Japan.

incidents.title: Minkabu: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Minkabu stated that unauthorised access may have leaked some customers' asset amounts. The company disclosed this possibility on 27 November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Monex Securities: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Monex Securities reported that identity-verification documents were leaked and offered ¥5,000 compensation to affected customers. The disclosure date was 27 November 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: YKK AP: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. YKK AP reported that 489 individuals were affected through contractor JP Tokyo & Company via its Otameshi Reform app service which was suspended. The disclosure was made on 27 November. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Clayton: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Clayton Corporation sent notices dated 4 November 2026 to current and former employees saying files accessed in a data security incident may have held their Social Security numbers driver’s licence numbers and direct deposit bank details. Fenton Missouri is the location. United States.

incidents.title: Port Authority of Livorno: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The Port Authority of Livorno suffered an external intrusion on Sunday afternoon that locked up and crashed its IT infrastructure. Computers at Palazzo Rosciano and other operational offices were disconnected. Livorno, Italy.

incidents.title: Kinatico: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Kinatico Limited reported a cybersecurity breach impacting its Cited™ platform with personal data of 320 individuals compromised. The announcement was made on 27 November. Melbourne, Australia.

incidents.title: Dirección General de Casinos: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The Dirección General de Casinos suspended some administrative operations and temporarily closed two venues as a precaution. Montevideo is the location. Montevideo, Uruguay.

incidents.title: Mitsui Shopping Park: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Mitsui Shopping Park disclosed that unauthorised access to its app resulted in approximately 3.12 million members' personal information, including names, addresses and phone numbers, leaking. The disclosure was made on November 27, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Department of Work and Pensions: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 27 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. The Department of Work and Pensions took all its online welfare and pension services offline after a cyber incident. The department confirmed the outage as a precaution and said benefit payments continue. United Kingdom.

incidents.title: GoDaddy: Reported ransomware attack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 27 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. A data leak linked to Inception ransomware was reported against GoDaddy on November 27, 2026. Tempe, United States.

incidents.title: Revolut: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 27 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. Revolut blocked cards after a security incident occurred at a payment provider it uses. London, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: Lucky Bike: Reported data breach, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 27 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. An unauthorized access on 20 November led to maintenance mode and possible access to customer data, excluding payment data. Germany.

incidents.title: Infflux: Claimed by The Gentlemen, not confirmed
incidents.description: The Gentlemen claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 27 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. The ransomware group The Gentlemen listed Infflux on its leak site. The nature and volume of any compromised data were not disclosed. Vincennes, France.

incidents.title: Department for Work and Pensions (DWP): Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The Department for Work and Pensions took nearly all online pensions and benefits services offline as a precaution after identifying a cyber incident affecting its systems. The department stated there was no evidence of customer data loss and that regular benefit and pension payments would continue as normal. London, United Kingdom.

incidents.title: US Air Force Cloud One: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. The US Air Force's flagship Cloud One computing platform was breached, disrupting IT operations. US Cyber Command is investigating the extent of the breach. Washington, United States.

incidents.title: Barclays Bank Delaware: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. An unauthorized party accessed Barclays Bank Delaware’s credit card application status system, exposing names, contact details, birth dates, and Social Security numbers. Barclays has confirmed the breach and reported it to authorities. Wilmington, United States.

incidents.title: KARTE: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. KARTE reported an unauthorized access that exposed data of approximately 1.2 billion individuals. The company confirmed the breach but details about the attacker remain unknown. Japan.

incidents.title: Hugendubel: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 27 Nov 2026. Hugendubel experienced a cyber attack that may have exposed customer data. The company has confirmed the incident and provided answers to common questions. Munich, Germany.

incidents.title: Centre hospitalier de Cadillac: Reported cyberattack, not yet confirmed
incidents.description: Reported by the press on 27 Nov 2026. The organisation has not confirmed it yet. The Centre hospitalier de Cadillac was attacked by a cyber‑attack during the night of 22–23 November 2026. The hospital confirmed the incident and that no data breach was detected. France.

incidents.title: SAP SE: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. SAP SE confirmed a security incident it refers to internally as 'Project Granite', reporting no evidence of unauthorised access to customer business data. Reports indicated hackers may have accessed SAP's source code using compromised employee credentials or tokens. Germany.

incidents.title: FANCL: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. FANCL disclosed that a third party gained unauthorised access to a contractor's database containing counselling data from its in-store Skin Check Scope service leaking 148,393 measurement data records. Names and credit card information were not among the leaked items. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Agence France-Presse: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Agence France-Presse isolated its Forum subscriber platform after an attack at about 01:30 Paris time on 26 November. The agency temporarily disabled its client platform for distributing news, photographs and video. Paris, France.

incidents.title: Renta 4 Banco: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Renta 4 Banco detected unauthorized access to personal identification data. No credentials or financial data were affected, and the incident was reported to regulators. Madrid, Spain.

incidents.title: Peach Aviation: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Up to approximately 9.44 million customer records were affected through unauthorized access to the external service KARTE. Osaka, Japan.

incidents.title: Mitsui Fudosan: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. About 3.119 million members' data was exposed through unauthorized access to the Mitsui Shopping Park app. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Persol Career (doda): Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. More than 610,000 job-seeker records were affected through Dentsu Digital's TONARIWA service. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Shueisha: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Shueisha announced that an external 'KARTE' service used for email distribution and part of its app was subjected to unauthorized access, leaking more than 700,000 records including birth dates. The incident was disclosed on November 26, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Kokubu Group: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. 8,590 records were possibly exposed through unauthorized access to KARTE affecting the ROJI Nihonbashi online store. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: New Balance Japan: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. New Balance Japan disclosed that unauthorised access to the KARTE service resulted in up to approximately 3.74 million records, including about 120,000 email addresses, leaking. The disclosure was made on November 26, 2026. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: Mitsubishi Estate: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. 103,605 records across eight services were exposed through unauthorized access to KARTE, including internal IDs and names. Tokyo, Japan.

incidents.title: AFC: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. An administrative account on AFC's e-commerce site was accessed without authorization, with up to 302,580 customers' personal data viewed or downloaded. Japan.

incidents.title: Shinka: Confirmed data breach
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 26 Nov 2026. Unauthorized access to an internal business system server resulted in 5,286 confirmed records being exposed. Japan.
